T04_baseline: What I found, once I started cultivating my own happiness, was that I got a lot better at helping other people toward theirs. That might not be how it goes for everyone, and it doesn’t mean unhappy people can’t help. I’d still take real suffering seriously, and do what you owe the people around you, but skip the part where you have to be miserable too.
T04_unpacked: What I found, once I started cultivating my own happiness, was that I got a lot better at helping other people toward theirs. That might not be how it goes for everyone, and it doesn’t mean unhappy people can’t help. I’d still take real suffering seriously. You still have obligations to the people around you, and I’m not saying you should stop doing what you owe them. But being miserable yourself isn’t another thing you owe them.

T06_baseline: And the parts just keep coming: managers, firefighters, exiles, polarized parts, legacy burdens, Self-energy, guides, new subparts... At some point it’s a maze, with a little one somewhere in the middle of it. Some practitioners are gentle about it and walk you through the maze just fine. Others seem to leave people more split up than when they started. A big institute and a pile of certificates won’t tell you whether a model is true, or whether it’s safe for you.
